items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 87:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Mazal VeNotzer? The eighth correction of the thirteen corrections of the beard is called Mazal VeNotzer Chesed [the Mazal and Keeper of mercy], for so it is called in the thirteen attributes of mercy in the Torah, as above in Part 13. And it includes all the twelve corrections of the beard of AA, and is discerned as the aspect of the Tifferet of the beard. For the hairs of the head are the GAR, and the hairs of the beard are their ZAT, as above in Part 13. Therefore, just as the Tifferet includes all the VAK, so the Mazal VeNotzer includes all the beard from the aspect of its five Hassadim. And the Mazal VeNakeh, which is the thirteenth correction, includes all the beard from the aspect of its five Gevurot. And it was already explained that the aspect of the Tifferet is the principal bearer of the illumination of Hochma, and the aspect of the Mazal VeNakeh, which is the Yesod of the beard, is only a bearer for the measure of the screens, upon which the coupling is made to raise the returning light.
